title: Allotopic Expression of ND6 Restores Vision in a Mitochondrial Disease Model.
intervention: AAV2-ND6 allotopic expression construct (codon-optimized with mitochondrial targeting sequence)

outcomes.name: visual function
outcomes.effect_text: restored visual function in ND6P25L mice

outcomes.name: retinal cellular deficiencies and optic nerve damage
outcomes.effect_text: mitigated retinal cellular deficiencies and optic nerve damage

outcomes.name: disease progression
outcomes.effect_text: pre-symptomatic intervention with AAV2-ND6 effectively attenuated disease progression

outcomes.name: mitochondrial dysfunction
outcomes.effect_text: allotopic ND6 expression markedly rescued the mitochondrial dysfunction
